algorithm: Explicit immutable physical footprints; exact 3D AABB interiors; support footprint containment and exact base/support height; Euclidean disk-inflated 0.1m grid, stable 4-neighbor BFS from existing entry
limitations: Static footprint and support planning only; Unity Player movement, actual Collider shape, rendered silhouette and lighting remain untested here.
A source image must be mapped to its declared physical template; per-instance arbitrary scale/rotation is forbidden.
Some assets are still pending production. Placement records are not evidence those assets exist or are integrated.
Radius uses B32 prefab value .5m plus .1m design margin; not a new runtime player measurement.
Conservative static route does not validate facing, rendered extents, interactions, door-leaf swing or live Unity physics.
